description: Find places by name or category, optionally near a location. Each one says whether it is open right now where that is known, rather than raw opening-hours text to interpret

lat.description: Optional latitude, if the location is already known

lon.description: Optional longitude, if the location is already known

near.description: Optional place to search near, e.g. 'Shoreditch, London' or 'SF'

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'ramen', 'pharmacy', 'Blue Bottle Coffee'

name: places_search
title: Search places
